title: An announcement to all animals
subject: English
unit: Spring 1: Animal Farm (George Orwell): power, propaganda and corruption
source: Written for english/y8 lesson 19 (Teacher-written farm announcement (pupil PDF))
intro: Lesson 19. Read the announcement. Underline every passive verb. Why might the writer choose the passive voice?

passage.title: NOTICE TO ALL ANIMALS OF THE FARM
paras: It has been decided that the weekly meeting will no longer be held. All decisions will be made by a special committee of pigs, and the animals will be informed in due course.

Comrades, it must be understood that certain changes to the food ration have been made. Mistakes in last month's figures were discovered and have now been corrected. Extra food has been allocated to those whose work is considered most important.
The windmill was damaged during the storm. The causes are being investigated, and those responsible will be dealt with.
Questions about these arrangements are not required. Every animal is thanked for its loyalty.
passage.source: Teacher-written for TGA in the style of George Orwell's Animal Farm.

questions.q: Rewrite the first sentence in the active voice. What changes?
questions.a: For example: 'Napoleon has decided that we will no longer hold the weekly meeting.' The active voice names who decided, so readers can see who holds the power.
